subject: ONE hyena in a sweat-dark work shirt, long grin, wiry legs, bare forepaws split with thick yellow calluses, hind paws driving the wheel in EVERY beat, never held in one pose
second_characters: ONE vulture clerk riding the wheel rim, swinging a longer bill across the lens in EVERY beat; TWO debtors hauling crates across the lens at his shoulder in EVERY beat

props.big: ONE great wooden wheel as broad as the frame, spinning under his paws in EVERY beat; from 7.05 ONE tiny wheel no taller than his knee
props.small: A SWARM of blank bill paper and grit tearing past the lens

environment: a walled payout yard packed with ledger crates and queueing debtors, top and bottom, no open sky
lighting: hard midday daylight, dust in the air, cyan edge left, amber fill right
motion_rule: the frame is TALL, the hyena fills half its height in EVERY beat, his grin a quarter of it. His hind paws never leave the rim: the wheel spins under him in EVERY beat, swinging the yard round him. Nothing is held up still - what reaches him is knocked on past the lens the same beat. The clerk and the debtors tear past the lens the full frame width in EVERY beat, never further off than his shoulder. The camera never stops, new shot size every beat, medium to very close. ONE hero action per beat.

audio.pacing: first word at 0.0, every line said once, last word done by 4.65, then the wheel carries it
audio.lip_sync: mouth to the lens, opening on every syllable
audio.pronunciation: ra-BO-tal ne po-kla-DA-ya LAP, po-lu-CHIL TOL-ko mo-ZO-li i SCHOT

timeline.a: he slams the wheel over with both forepaws, chest down into the stride, the clerk swinging a bill across the lens
the clerk rides the rim unrolling a bill longer than the hyena across the lens as he shoulders the wheel
he pounds the wheel round, hurling his body down into every stride, two debtors crossing the lens at his shoulder, paper tearing past
driving the wheel on, he swings both calloused pads up past his grin and back into the rim, sweeping them across the lens
the clerk flings a fat roll of bills into his chest and he knocks it over his shoulder mid-stride
he stamps the wheel round harder and the roll unrolls off his shoulder past the lens, the clerk after it
he rips the strip out of the air in his teeth and hurls it past the lens without breaking stride
the clerk rolls the great wheel out past the lens and swings ONE tiny wheel in, and he drops onto it mid-stride
he treads the tiny wheel, knees slamming to his chin, the yard tearing past
the clerk pins a fresh bill to the tiny wheel and it whips past the lens as he drives harder
the clerk rips the tiny wheel out from under him past the lens and he slams the stride down onto nothing, muzzle filling the frame
he treads bare air on the spot, knees pumping, grin cracking wider, debtors tearing past

must_appear: at 0.00 both forepaws slamming the wheel; at 4.65 the calloused pads sweeping across the lens; at 7.05 ONE tiny wheel under his paws; at 9.10 his stride slamming down onto nothing
negative_prompt: cyrillic words, digits, subtitles, a hero running at the camera on his feet, a travelling camera, a parked camera, a still or empty background, a wide shot, a small distant hero, letterbox, a horizontal 16:9 picture, a hero back to the camera, a hero held in one pose, a prop held up at the lens, both forepaws off the rim, a motionless first or last second, a line said twice, speech after 4.65, English speech
